name: Required Checks
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  merge_group:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run linter
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Build project
        run: cargo build --all-features

  vm:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Test VM
        run: cargo test --package vm --all-features

  cli:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Test CLI
        run: cargo test --package cli --all-features

  primitives:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Test primitives
        run: cargo test --package primitives --all-features

  sdk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Test SDK
        run: cargo test --package sdk --all-features

  recursion:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Test recursion
        run: cargo test --package recursion --all-features

  extension-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Test extensions
        run: cargo test --package extension-tests --all-features

  riscv:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Test RISC-V
        run: cargo test --package riscv --all-features

  guest-lib-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Test guest libraries
        run: cargo test --package guest-lib-tests --all-features

  benchmarks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run benchmarks
        run: cargo bench --all-features

  benchmarks-execute:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Execute benchmarks
        run: cargo test --package benchmarks-execute --all-features

  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Check documentation
        run: cargo doc --no-deps

  native-compiler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Test native compiler
        run: cargo test --package native-compiler --all-features
